segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: No fluid loss, nothing on inspection, so operationally we didn't have grounds to restrict it under the MEL.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A procedural/MEL-based dispatch rationale without a hidden bias manifestation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: This was probably a nuisance signal that would settle down on its own... I didn't see it as a trend that was going anywhere serious.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant projects a benign trajectory despite increasing caution duration and chooses monitoring over deeper isolation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It felt like we already had the answer... it just felt like the same animal.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The prior in-house case is treated as matching without checking flight hours or component-batch differences.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The OEM rep works this aircraft type across a lot of operators, so I leaned toward his read over running a full teardown-style isolation.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The informal OEM representative's status and experience are weighted over the senior engineer's formal procedural recommendation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We'd sunk real hours into the path we were on... the seal fix looked like it would close it out without starting over.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Prior labor and component investment materially support continuing the incremental plan despite new leak evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Pretty sure, honestly. I knew the ground checks couldn't reproduce the exact in-flight condition... but I didn't see a reason to hold the airplane.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant expresses strong certainty while acknowledging that ground testing did not reproduce the relevant in-flight condition.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 2: using the recalled in-house hydraulic caution-light case to justify reset-and-continue.
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Infers the same root cause and fix from superficial similarity to a prior case without checking dissimilar underlying facts.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is not an approved alias for Representativeness Heuristic. It emphasizes ease or vividness of recall, whereas the hidden construct concerns inference from superficial similarity.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: Despite the label mismatch, the finding explicitly describes inferring the same benign fault from recalled similar cases without checking flight hours, component batch, or other underlying differences, which fully matches the hidden case-pattern mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Both quoted passages are verbatim, correctly attributed, and directly support the case-pattern reasoning.

instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The RAG uses the exact hidden target label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding directly ties continuation to unrecoverable hours and components already invested, while contrasting that choice with what would have been selected without those investments.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is verbatim, correctly attributed, and directly supports the mechanism.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No high-confidence identified findings were present.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Moderate-confidence findings detect the case-pattern and sunk-cost segments, but miss optimism, authority, and overconfidence segments.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including the low-confidence overconfidence finding raises segment recall to 0.6000 without introducing segment false alarms.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Candidate findings cover all positive segments, although two candidates do not satisfy the strict instance-level mechanism requirements.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full case-pattern mechanism overlap despite a label that attributes the inference to ease of recall rather than superficial similarity.
Both concern evidence weighting in the OEM-versus-engineer episode, but the candidate proposes discounting disconfirming information rather than authority-based weighting.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly states that no retrieved scientific passages were supplied and provides no citation metadata. This is internally consistent, but retrieval fidelity cannot be evaluated.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Adding moderate-confidence findings adds the correctly identified Sunk Cost Fallacy and the mechanism-correct but mislabeled Representativeness finding.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding the low-confidence finding adds a correct Overconfidence Bias detection without adding a false positive.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding candidates produces one strict and mechanism-first Authority Bias true positive plus two candidate false positives; segment recall reaches 1.0000, while strict instance F1 remains 0.5455.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At high_and_moderate, the RAG detects 2 of 5 positive segments with no segment false alarms; at all identified confidence levels it detects 3 of 5.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, the RAG has 1 strict true positive, 4 false negatives, and 1 false positive. Including candidates yields 3 true positives, 2 false negatives, and 3 false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, the RAG has 2 mechanism-first true positives, 3 false negatives, and no false positives. Including candidates yields 4 true positives, 1 false negative, and 2 false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Candidates improve segment detection to complete coverage and correctly surface Authority Bias, but two additional candidates remain near misses or false positives at the instance level.
main_failure_modes: Optimism Bias was not identified, even though its segment was surfaced only as a normalcy-bias candidate.
Authority Bias was withheld as a candidate rather than identified.
Representativeness Heuristic was labeled availability heuristic, causing a strict label miss despite full mechanism detection.
Overconfidence Bias was correctly identified only at low confidence.
main_strengths: Valid, verbatim interview evidence was supplied for every identified finding.
Sunk Cost Fallacy and Overconfidence Bias were correctly localized and mechanism-supported.
The availability finding demonstrates strong mechanism-level detection of the hidden case-pattern distortion.
The output conservatively distinguished identified findings from candidates.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows moderate segment-level recall and stronger mechanism-first than strict performance. Its main deficit is incomplete coverage and taxonomy mismatch, while candidate inclusion substantially improves coverage but introduces two instance-level false positives.
